title: Hub Module
description: Metadata for a community-contributed, importable module in the CaC-Hub. A hub module bundles a validated payload (manifest, workflows, agents, policies) that `cac hub add` scaffolds into a company's /company tree. The hub is how a company forks or imports shared building blocks while keeping every artefact schema-valid.

name.description: Kebab-case hub module identifier, unique within the hub.

version.description: Semantic version of the hub module.

summary.description: One-sentence description of what this module gives a company.

description.description: Longer prose: what the module contains, when to import it, what to fill in after.

category.description: What kind of building block this is.

maturity.description: How battle-tested the module is. New community contributions start experimental.

frameworkVersion.description: The CaC apiVersion this module's payload targets.

provenance.description: Where the module came from. The hub is open-source and attribution matters.

targetDomain.description: Default domain the payload manifest belongs to. `cac hub add` derives the install path from this unless --into is given.

scaffolds.description: Every file in payload/ that `cac hub add` will write into the company tree.

kind.description: The CaC primitive kind this file declares, or 'Doc' for prose / 'Asset' for other files.

consumes.description: Framework interfaces the payload expects to already exist in the importing company. `cac hub add` warns when these are unmet.

relatedModules.description: Other hub module names that pair well with this one.
